# Geometry Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GeometryType`](gmeow-GeometryType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GeometryType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The structural kind of a geometry (point, line, polygon, multipoint, multilinestring, multipolygon). A value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) aligned by reference to GeoSPARQL simple-features ([sf:Point](http://www.opengis.net/ont/sf#Point), [sf:LineString](http://www.opengis.net/ont/sf#LineString), [sf:Polygon](http://www.opengis.net/ont/sf#Polygon), etc.).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GeometryType`](gmeow-GeometryType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to mint or reference a structural geometry kind (point, line, polygon, multi*) aligned to GeoSPARQL simple features.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md) for a shape kind (it is a value, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint or reuse a [`gmeow:GeometryType`](gmeow-GeometryType.md) individual and reference it from a [`Geometry`](gmeow-Geometry.md) via [`gmeow:geometryType`](../properties/gmeow-geometryType.md).

### Examples

- ex:geometryTypeCircle a [`gmeow:GeometryType`](gmeow-GeometryType.md).
